chunks: Aḥmad ibn Muḥammad ibn ʿĪsā, from Muḥammad ibn Sahl, from Zakariyyā ibn Ādam, said:
I asked al-Riḍā عليه السلام about a man who had intercourse with his wife’s slave-girl while she had not gifted her to him. He said: “He is a fornicator; stoning is upon him.”

key_terms.الرَّجْمُ: stoning as the prescribed hadd punishment

ai.seo_question: What is the ruling if a man has intercourse with his wife’s slave-girl without her gifting the slave-girl to him?
ai.summary: This hadith gives a legal ruling concerning a man who has intercourse with his wife’s slave-girl without lawful transfer of ownership. Imam al-Riḍā عليه السلام rules that the act is zina and that the prescribed hadd punishment applies.
